<xsl:stylesheet xmlns="event-logging:3" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:stroom="stroom" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:mcp="stroom-mcp:functions" version="3.0" xpath-default-namespace="records:2" exclude-result-prefixes="stroom xs mcp">
  <xsl:variable name="result_to_success" as="map(xs:string, xs:string)">
    <xsl:map>
      <xsl:map-entry key="'ok'" select="'true'"/>
      <xsl:map-entry key="'fail'" select="'false'"/>
    </xsl:map>
  </xsl:variable>
  <xsl:template match="records">
    <Events Version="4.1.0" xsi:schemaLocation="event-logging:3 file://event-logging-v4.1.0.xsd">
      <xsl:apply-templates select="record" mode="event"/>
    </Events>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="*" mode="event">
    <xsl:choose>
      <xsl:when test="data[@name='action']/@value = 'login'">
        <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="event_type_logon"/>
      </xsl:when>
      <xsl:otherwise>
        <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="event_type_other"/>
      </xsl:otherwise>
    </xsl:choose>
  </xsl:template>
  <!-- Rule 'logon': records where action = login. Writes an Authenticate event (TypeId Logon) from user, result, sid. -->
  <xsl:template match="node()" mode="event_type_logon">
    <Event>
      <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="event_time"/>
      <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="event_source"/>
      <EventDetail>
        <TypeId>Logon</TypeId>
        <Authenticate>
          <Action>Logon</Action>
          <xsl:if test="normalize-space(data[@name='user']/@value)">
            <User>
              <Id>
                <xsl:value-of select="data[@name='user']/@value"/>
              </Id>
            </User>
          </xsl:if>
          <xsl:variable name="result" select="data[@name='result']/@value[normalize-space(.)]"/>
          <xsl:if test="exists($result_to_success?($result))">
            <Outcome>
              <Success>
                <xsl:value-of select="$result_to_success?($result)[1]"/>
              </Success>
            </Outcome>
          </xsl:if>
          <xsl:sequence select="mcp:data('session', data[@name='sid']/@value)"/>
          <xsl:if test="exists($result_to_success?($result))">
            <Data Name="outcome" Value="{$result_to_success?($result)[1]}"/>
          </xsl:if>
        </Authenticate>
      </EventDetail>
    </Event>
  </xsl:template>
  <!-- Rule 'other': records no other rule matches. Writes an Unknown event (TypeId from action) from action. -->
  <xsl:template match="node()" mode="event_type_other">
    <Event>
      <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="event_time"/>
      <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="event_source"/>
      <EventDetail>
        <xsl:variable name="action" select="data[@name='action']/@value[normalize-space(.)]"/>
        <TypeId>
          <xsl:value-of select="if ($action) then $action else 'other'"/>
        </TypeId>
        <Unknown>
          <Data Name="kind" Value="{if ($action = 'login') then 'Logon' else 'Other'}"/>
        </Unknown>
      </EventDetail>
    </Event>
  </xsl:template>
  <!-- event_time: shared by the rules 'logon', 'other' -->
  <xsl:template match="node()" mode="event_time">
    <xsl:if test="normalize-space(data[@name='time']/@value)">
      <EventTime>
        <TimeCreated>
          <xsl:value-of select="data[@name='time']/@value"/>
        </TimeCreated>
      </EventTime>
    </xsl:if>
  </xsl:template>
  <!-- event_source: shared by the rules 'logon', 'other' -->
  <xsl:template match="node()" mode="event_source">
    <EventSource>
      <System>
        <Name>Acme VPN</Name>
        <Environment>Dev</Environment>
      </System>
      <Generator>vpnd</Generator>
      <Device>
        <HostName>
          <xsl:value-of select="if (normalize-space(data[@name='host']/@value)) then data[@name='host']/@value else 'unknown'"/>
        </HostName>
      </Device>
      <xsl:if test="normalize-space(data[@name='user']/@value)">
        <User>
          <Id>
            <xsl:value-of select="data[@name='user']/@value"/>
          </Id>
        </User>
      </xsl:if>
    </EventSource>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:function name="mcp:data" as="element()?">
    <!-- A Data entry, Name and Value, when the value is present (not blank) -->
    <xsl:param name="name" as="xs:string"/>
    <xsl:param name="value" as="item()*"/>
    <xsl:if test="exists($value[normalize-space(.)])">
      <Data Name="{$name}" Value="{$value}"/>
    </xsl:if>
  </xsl:function>
</xsl:stylesheet>

            <xsl:value-of select="mcp:parse_time($time[1])"/>
          </TimeCreated>
        </EventTime>

        </xsl:if>

            <User>

          </xsl:if>

    </xsl:if>

    <xsl:sequence select="stroom:format-date($value, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss', '+10:00')"/>
  </xsl:function>

<xsl:stylesheet xmlns="event-logging:3" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:stroom="stroom" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:fn="http://www.w3.org/2005/xpath-functions" version="3.0" xpath-default-namespace="http://www.w3.org/2013/XSL/json" exclude-result-prefixes="stroom xs fn">
  <xsl:template match="/">
    <Events Version="4.1.0" xsi:schemaLocation="event-logging:3 file://event-logging-v4.1.0.xsd">
      <xsl:apply-templates select="/map/map" mode="event"/>
    </Events>
  </xsl:template>
  <xsl:template match="*" mode="event">
    <xsl:variable name="ts_parts" select="analyze-string(string(*[@key='message'][1]), '^(\S+) (\S+) (\S+) (.*)$')"/>
    <xsl:choose>
      <xsl:when test="$ts_parts/fn:match//fn:group[@nr=3] = 'LOGIN'">
        <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="event_type_logon"/>
      </xsl:when>
      <xsl:when test="$ts_parts/fn:match//fn:group[@nr=3] = 'LOGOUT'">
        <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="event_type_logoff"/>
      </xsl:when>
      <xsl:when test="not(normalize-space($ts_parts/fn:match//fn:group[@nr=1]))">
        <!-- unparsed: left untranslated on purpose -->
      </xsl:when>
    </xsl:choose>
  </xsl:template>
  <!-- Rule 'logon': records where action = LOGIN. Writes an Authenticate event (TypeId from action) from user
       (extracted from message). -->
  <xsl:template match="node()" mode="event_type_logon">
    <Event>
      <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="event_time"/>
      <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="event_source"/>
      <EventDetail>
        <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="type_id"/>
        <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="description"/>
        <Authenticate>
          <Action>Logon</Action>
          <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="user"/>
        </Authenticate>
      </EventDetail>
    </Event>
  </xsl:template>
  <!-- Rule 'logoff': records where action = LOGOUT. Writes an Authenticate event (TypeId from action) from user
       (extracted from message). -->
  <xsl:template match="node()" mode="event_type_logoff">
    <Event>
      <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="event_time"/>
      <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="event_source"/>
      <EventDetail>
        <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="type_id"/>
        <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="description"/>
        <Authenticate>
          <Action>Logoff</Action>
          <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="user"/>
        </Authenticate>
      </EventDetail>
    </Event>
  </xsl:template>
  <!-- event_time: shared by the rules 'logon', 'logoff' -->
  <xsl:template match="node()" mode="event_time">
    <xsl:variable name="ts_parts" select="analyze-string(string(*[@key='message'][1]), '^(\S+) (\S+) (\S+) (.*)$')"/>
    <xsl:if test="normalize-space($ts_parts/fn:match//fn:group[@nr=1])">
      <EventTime>
        <TimeCreated>
          <xsl:value-of select="$ts_parts/fn:match//fn:group[@nr=1]"/>
        </TimeCreated>
      </EventTime>
    </xsl:if>
  </xsl:template>
  <!-- event_source: shared by the rules 'logon', 'logoff' -->
  <xsl:template match="node()" mode="event_source">
    <EventSource>
      <System>
        <Name>App</Name>
        <Environment>Dev</Environment>
      </System>
      <Generator>app</Generator>
      <xsl:if test="normalize-space(*[@key='host'])">
        <Device>
          <HostName>
            <xsl:value-of select="*[@key='host']"/>
          </HostName>
        </Device>
      </xsl:if>
      <xsl:variable name="ts_parts" select="analyze-string(string(*[@key='message'][1]), '^(\S+) (\S+) (\S+) (.*)$')"/>
      <xsl:if test="normalize-space($ts_parts/fn:match//fn:group[@nr=2])">
        <User>
          <Id>
            <xsl:value-of select="$ts_parts/fn:match//fn:group[@nr=2]"/>
          </Id>
        </User>
      </xsl:if>
    </EventSource>
  </xsl:template>
  <!-- type_id: shared by the rules 'logon', 'logoff' -->
  <xsl:template match="node()" mode="type_id">
    <xsl:variable name="ts_parts" select="analyze-string(string(*[@key='message'][1]), '^(\S+) (\S+) (\S+) (.*)$')"/>
    <xsl:if test="normalize-space($ts_parts/fn:match//fn:group[@nr=3])">
      <TypeId>
        <xsl:value-of select="$ts_parts/fn:match//fn:group[@nr=3]"/>
      </TypeId>
    </xsl:if>
  </xsl:template>
  <!-- description: shared by the rules 'logon', 'logoff' -->
  <xsl:template match="node()" mode="description">
    <xsl:variable name="ts_parts" select="analyze-string(string(*[@key='message'][1]), '^(\S+) (\S+) (\S+) (.*)$')"/>
    <xsl:if test="normalize-space($ts_parts/fn:match//fn:group[@nr=4])">
      <Description>
        <xsl:value-of select="$ts_parts/fn:match//fn:group[@nr=4]"/>
      </Description>
    </xsl:if>
  </xsl:template>
  <!-- user: shared by the rules 'logon', 'logoff' -->
  <xsl:template match="node()" mode="user">
